title: Work tape head positions under symbol lifting
statement: Let $e: ool	o	ext{Γ}$ be an injective map, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. The positions of the heads on all work tapes in the configuration obtained by lifting $c$ through $e$ equal the corresponding positions in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from Boolean symbols to symbols in Γ
